name: cable seated neck extension (with head harness)
description: Seated with a harness attached to a cable, you pull your head back against steady resistance to train the neck extensors.
instructions: Fit the head harness and sit facing the cable with it attached at head height.
Start with your head tipped slightly forward.
Pull your head back until it is upright.
Pause, then return slowly against the cable.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.
